entries.0d9553b6f1faacdb: Original exterior wall materials and renovation work
entries.0ea49dabd9a614c9: Its main customers are owners of general homes in the Hokkaido, Tohoku and Kanto areas, and sales staff create opportunities for negotiation through door-to-door visits and sell directly. In materials sales, its customers are corporate entities such as building contractors.
entries.0f08b7c46a068411: It manufactures its original exterior wall materials at its own factory and at ＯＥＭ partners, sells exterior wall renovation work directly to homeowners through its branch sales staff, and earns revenue through a system in which designated contractors carry out the construction.
entries.1a1b7817a32407ef: It has set out the basic policy “Happy End Creation Company” and focuses on three points: raising its value as a comprehensive exterior wall manufacturer that performs everything from manufacturing and sales through construction to maintenance, expanding its sales area centered on the Kanto region, and strengthening staffing and talent development. It positions its own-brand tile panel “Sidinger” as its core product, and considers promoting its adoption and strengthening its production and supply system at its own factories to be important issues.
entries.1d42e431e5c316c1: This business provides comprehensive renovation works for residential homes, including painting other than exterior walls, exteriors, interiors and water-related areas.
entries.34f0a137be9f6c3c: Wholesale sales of exterior wall materials and construction supplies
entries.3961f03ebd9b6603: Original exterior wall materials “Happy End Series” (tile panels “Sidinger,” dry-process tiles, metal siding, etc.)
entries.4ec23a221e1a0180: An exterior wall renovation company headquartered in Chuo-ku, Sapporo, with branches in Sapporo, Sendai and Yokohama. As of December 31, 2025, it had 40 employees.
entries.4f256d12626266e4: It manufactures the tile panel “Sidinger” at its Ishikari Factory and supplies it together with exterior wall materials developed in collaboration with ＯＥＭ manufacturers. It provides, consistently from proposal through construction to maintenance, “overlay” work that lays new exterior wall materials over existing walls.
entries.4fe1d0854f201e6e: Construction fees for exterior wall renovation work
entries.5eccbf388546f402: Based on management’s analysis of financial position, operating results and cash flow status, and business description.
entries.613dc1163165d257: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥989,140 thousand. The breakdown is exterior wall renovation work ¥775 million, other renovation work ¥120 million and materials sales ¥93 million.
entries.665a1ba96d01382c: This is the main business, offering proposals, construction and maintenance for exterior wall 'overlap' renovation using the tile panel 'Saidinga' manufactured at the company's own factory (Ishikari Factory) and the original exterior wall material 'Happy End Series' developed in cooperation with ＯＥＭ manufacturers. Construction is outsourced to designated contractors that meet the company's standards (40 companies as of the end of December 2025), and sales are conducted through direct door-to-door sales by the Sapporo, Sendai and Yokohama branches. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥775 million; by region, the Hokkaido area was ¥424 million, the Tohoku area ¥235 million, and the Kanto area ¥114 million.
entries.6f677bb0306a998f: Corporate Customers such as Local Builders
entries.72f158835a888b4f: This business sells the company's original exterior wall materials and construction materials, developed in cooperation with ＯＥＭ manufacturers, directly and wholesale to corporate customers such as local builders. It handles the same products as the building materials used in exterior wall renovation works. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥93 million.
entries.746197c4835eede4: Other renovation work (painting, exterior works, interior, water-related areas, etc.)
entries.7de81daf10a20cfc: This business sells the company's original exterior wall materials and construction materials, developed in cooperation with ＯＥＭ manufacturers, directly and wholesale to corporate customers such as local builders.
entries.8071e1eec1a26d7c: This is the main business, offering proposals, construction and maintenance for exterior wall 'overlap' renovation using the tile panel 'Saidinga' manufactured at the company's own factory (Ishikari Factory) and the original exterior wall material 'Happy End Series' developed in cooperation with ＯＥＭ manufacturers.
entries.a93196f59956e296: This business provides comprehensive renovation works for residential homes, including painting other than exterior walls, exteriors, interiors and water-related areas. In addition to proposals to the customers of exterior wall renovation works, it undertakes works contracted from local builders and housebuilders, with construction carried out by subcontracted contractors. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥120 million.
entries.ade047b86c0dccdc: Based on business description, segment information, management policy, business environment and issues to be addressed, etc.
entries.b53b22853843fae4: In the fiscal year ended December 2025, orders fell due to lower consumer sentiment from rising prices, and revenue decreased 11.2% from the previous year to ¥989,140 thousand. For the Kanto area, it is shifting its focus away from sales expansion by its sales department alone toward orders won through cooperation with business partners such as building contractors and dealers, and the policy presented is to concentrate its main markets in Hokkaido and the Tohoku area.
entries.b66e8b01689b7404: A remodeling company originating in Hokkaido that handles exterior wall renovation work using original exterior wall materials such as tile panels made at its own factory, from planning and proposals through construction to maintenance.
entries.c301a7892a34ecac: Construction fees for other renovation work
entries.e310833c97543ff5: It has technical capability built up through more than ten years of exterior wall renovation construction in Hokkaido, a cold region. Its exterior wall materials are tile panels manufactured at the Ishikari Factory and original products developed in collaboration with ＯＥＭ manufacturers, and they offer durability and insulation. Construction is outsourced only to designated contractors that meet its standards (40 as of the end of December 2025), and quality is maintained through a system that feeds back the content of post-construction customer surveys to the designated contractors.
entries.edc4913ff3b3793b: Based on segment information on revenue from external customers, management’s analysis of financial position, operating results and cash flow status, management policy, business environment and issues to be addressed, etc.
entries.fbd22a94106f809b: On the housing renovation market, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism’s “Basic Plan for Housing Life (National Plan)” shows the market size expanding from ¥12 trillion in 2018 to ¥14 trillion in 2030, with an indicator aiming for ¥20 trillion over the long term. The company is listed on the Sapporo Securities Exchange and is an exterior wall renovation company rooted in Hokkaido and expanding into the Tohoku and Kanto regions.
entries.fc54d466f61173cf: Due to recording a gain on the sale of the head office land, net income for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥107,442 thousand.
